senses.gloss:
लू लू, ii. 9, लुना, लुनी, Par. Ātm.
 1. To cut, to clip, MBh. 3, 15644.
 2. To destroy, Śiś. 1, 51.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लून.
 1. Cut, clipped, Pañc. i. d. 201; cut off.
 2. Wounded, Hit. iv. d. 77.
 3. Injured by biting, Hit. 58, 3.
 --With the prep. विप्र वि-प्र, विप्रलून, Severed, Utt. Rāmac. 53, 15.
 --Cf. λύω, ἀπο-λαύω; Lat. lucrum, solvo; akin are also Goth. fra-liusan; A.S. leosan, lysan, leás, los.
